# Mentr Learn — llms.txt (product slice)
# https://mentr.in/learn

Mentr Learn is free Class 3–5 CS + AI + Math for kids (Mentr Starter).
60-module syllabus · Watch → Quiz → Build → Practice · ₹0 · parent enroll · lifetime free track.
Available today: narrated lessons as they ship, quizzes, Build Arena, Practice, POTD.
